-- The Pajama Game (2019) - musical
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'The Pajama Game' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2019', '1950s', 'Labor Movement', 'University Theatre', 'Romance')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- Parliament Square (2019) - drama
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Parliament Square' AND t.name IN ('Drama', '2019', 'Political Theatre', 'Contemporary', 'British Theatre', 'University Theatre')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- American Idiot (2018) - rock musical
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'American Idiot' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2018', 'Rock Musical', 'Green Day', 'Contemporary', 'University Theatre')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
